turns.text: Hey there! Yes, Olive was actually pretty quiet last night, thankfully. I had a good start to the day. For breakfast, I made some eggs and toast.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.text: Grace is doing great. We are actually hoping to play some indoor tennis this weekend if we can get a court. The weather has been typical Portland rain, so outdoor courts are out of the question.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Indoor courts are definitely the way to go this time of year! I hope you two can snag a reservation. What are your plans for the rest of the evening? Just relaxing?

turns.text: Yeah, keeping it very low-key tonight. I'm probably just going to watch some sitcom reruns on TV and wind down.

turns.text: That sounds like a perfect way to spend a rainy Monday evening. Are you watching those sitcom reruns on that new streaming service you signed up for?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Yep, they have a whole catalog of classics on there, so it's been nice having that on in the background while I unwind.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: That does sound incredibly cozy. I'm sure Olive will be happy to curl up on the couch with you while you watch.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Oh, absolutely. She's already waiting by her favorite spot. Anyway, I'm going to head out and get some dinner started. Talk to you tomorrow!
